rows.note: Story: Dubai Developed in Fortnite 2033, independent Fortnite island by Wild Unlimited with DMCC Gaming Centre, built with UEFN, playable worldwide from 11 Nov 2026, launch event and Wild Game Fest at SALT, Kite Beach. Primary: DMCC press release 2 Nov 07:24Z (dmcc.ae/latest-news/dmcc-gaming-centre-and-wild-unlimited-announce-dubai-developed-in-fortnite-2033); reports: Arabian Business 2 Nov 19:31Z, PocketGamer.biz 2 Nov, Tbreak UAE. MUST SAY on every post and the Reel: built with Fortnite's creator tools (UEFN), an independent island, not made, sponsored, endorsed or administered by Epic Games. Landmarks named on screen from the release: Al Fahidi Fort, Almas Tower, Uptown Dubai, Skydive Dubai, Deep Dive Dubai, Kite Beach Dubai, SALT, Dubai Harbour, X-Dubai, American University in Dubai. Footage needed: Wild Unlimited's trailer or island capture (credit on screen, permission from Wild Unlimited or DMCC press contact if the file is theirs); not found yet (DMCC YouTube needs sign-in). Do not use Epic footage of other islands as the picture. Build on 10 Nov evening, schedule for the launch morning; the 'now' post is the earlier X and Threads one.
